title: Compose ranges and fold arguments
description: A range view describes how to process elements as they are requested. A fold expression combines a template's argument pack, which is a sequence of arguments.

steps.description: The numeric pipeline selects even values, squares them, and takes four results. The loop requests those results from the views.
The string pipeline splits text at spaces, constructs strings from the pieces, and selects strings longer than three characters.
sum_all folds + over its arguments. The comment shows the right-associated grouping.
print_all folds the comma operator over stream expressions, writing each supplied argument.
any_of_equal folds logical OR over comparisons with val. OR stops evaluating once a comparison succeeds.
fold_demo shows calls with several argument counts and types. The comments state results for the displayed numeric examples.
